parameters.sqlQuery:
-- AAC - 21: auto-approve marketing reviews nobody answered within 24 hours, then send them to WordPress.
-- WordPress is not the public site: the team still decides whether to push each article live through
-- Headless Hostman. Auto-approved articles are flagged in the dashboard for extra attention.
-- Only reviews requested in the last 7 days are auto-approved, so an older backlog is not sent all at once.
CREATE TEMP TABLE expired_marketing_reviews AS
SELECT
  ap.approval_id,
  ap.article_id,
  ap.requested_at,
  a.doctor_id,
  a.campaign_id,
  a.current_version
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` ap
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
  ON a.article_id = ap.article_id
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c
  ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE ap.approval_type = 'MARKETING_REVIEW'
  AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
  AND a.status = 'MARKETING_REVIEW'
  AND c.require_marketing_approval = TRUE
  AND ap.requested_at <= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
  AND ap.requested_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.article_id ORDER BY ap.requested_at DESC) = 1
LIMIT 25;

BEGIN TRANSACTION;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING expired_marketing_reviews S
ON T.approval_id = S.approval_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'AUTO_APPROVED',
  responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  response = 'Automatically approved after 24 hours without a marketing response.';

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links` T
USING expired_marketing_reviews S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.status IN ('READY', 'OPENED')
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'EXPIRED',
  responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` T
USING expired_marketing_reviews S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.status = 'MARKETING_REVIEW' AND T.current_version = S.current_version
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED',
  marketing_approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors` T
USING expired_marketing_reviews S
ON T.campaign_id = S.campaign_id AND T.doctor_id = S.doctor_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP();

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(),
  'article',
  article_id,
  'marketing.auto_approved',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'n8n:marketing-review-deadline',
  NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(approval_id, requested_at, current_version AS version_number))
FROM expired_marketing_reviews;

COMMIT TRANSACTION;

-- Articles to send to WordPress: the ones approved just now, plus any auto-approved in the last 7 days
-- whose WordPress send did not finish (so a failed send is retried on the next hourly run).
SELECT article_id FROM expired_marketing_reviews
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT a.article_id
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` ap
  ON ap.article_id = a.article_id AND ap.approval_type = 'MARKETING_REVIEW' AND ap.status = 'AUTO_APPROVED'
WHERE a.status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED'
  AND a.published_at IS NULL
  AND ap.responded_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  AND ap.responded_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE);

parameters.content:
## AAC 21 - Marketing auto-approval after 24 hours

Runs hourly. A marketing review that nobody approves or answers within 24 hours of the request is marked `AUTO_APPROVED` (article status `MARKETING_APPROVED`, event `marketing.auto_approved`) and sent to WordPress, one article at a time. WordPress is not the public site; the team still pushes live through Headless Hostman, and the dashboard flags auto-approved articles for extra attention.

Safety limits: only reviews requested in the last 7 days, at most 25 per run, and a failed WordPress send is retried on the next run for 7 days.

Connect the existing **Google BigQuery account** credential before activating.
